description: This file provides debugging utilities for the ANGLE project, including logging, debug annotations, performance event helpers, and macros for assertions and warnings.

classes.name: ScopedPerfEventHelper
classes.description: A class that pairs a D3D begin event with an end event for performance profiling.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Represents a log message with severity, function, and line info, allowing streaming of message content.

classes.name: DebugAnnotator
classes.description: Abstract class for platform-specific debug annotation functions.

classes.name: LogMessageVoidify
classes.description: Helper class to suppress unused value warnings in logging macros.

classes.name: FmtHexHelper
classes.description: Helper class for formatting hexadecimal values.

methods.name: ScopedPerfEventHelper
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for managing performance event scope.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and accessors for log message content.

methods.name: DebugAnnotator
methods.description: Virtual methods for debug annotation operations.

methods.name: InitializeDebugAnnotations
methods.description: Initializes debug annotation system with a DebugAnnotator.

methods.name: DebugAnnotationsActive
methods.description: Returns whether debug annotations are active.

methods.name: DebugAnnotationsInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether debug annotations are initialized.

methods.name: FmtHex
methods.description: Formats a value as hexadecimal with fixed width.

methods.description: Formats a value as hexadecimal with size based on type.

methods.name: FmtHexHelper
methods.description: Helper class for formatting hex values with optional prefix.
